00055  JuceIOHost(const int numInputs = 2, const int numOutputs = 2, const int preferredBufferSize = 0, const bool useTimerDeleter = false) throw()
00056  : numInputs_(numInputs < 0 ? 0 : numInputs),
00057   numOutputs_(numOutputs < 0 ? 0 : numOutputs),
00058   bufferSize(preferredBufferSize),
00059   juceDeleter(0)
00060  {
00061   ugen_assert(numInputs == numInputs_);
00062   ugen_assert(numOutputs == numOutputs_);
00063   ugen_assert(bufferSize == preferredBufferSize);
00064   
00065   //const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00066   lock.enter();
00067   UGen::initialise();
00068   if(useTimerDeleter) 
00069   {
00070    juceDeleter = new JuceTimerDeleter();
00071    UGen::setDeleter(juceDeleter);
00072   }
00073   
00074 #ifndef UGEN_NOEXTGPL
00075   Ran088::defaultGenerator().setSeed(Time::currentTimeMillis());
00076 #endif
00077   startTimer(50);
00078   
00079   output_ = Plug::AR(UGen::emptyChannels(numOutputs_));
00080   lock.exit();
00081  }

00098  void timerCallback()
00099  {
00100   stopTimer();
00101   
00102   String error = audioDeviceManager.initialise (numInputs_, numOutputs_, 0, true);
00103   
00104   if (error.isNotEmpty())
00105   {
00106    AlertWindow::showMessageBox (AlertWindow::WarningIcon, 
00107            T("JuceIOHost"), 
00108            T("AudioDeviceManager init failed \n\n") + error);
00109    
00110    return;
00111   }
00112 
00113   AudioDeviceManager::AudioDeviceSetup setup;
00114   audioDeviceManager.getAudioDeviceSetup(setup);
00115 
00116   if(bufferSize < 1)
00117   {
00118    bufferSize = setup.bufferSize;
00119   }
00120   else
00121   {
00122    setup.bufferSize = bufferSize;
00123    audioDeviceManager.setAudioDeviceSetup(setup, false);
00124   }
00125   
00126   if (error.isNotEmpty())
00127   {
00128    AlertWindow::showMessageBox (AlertWindow::WarningIcon, 
00129            T("JuceIOHost"), 
00130            T("AudioDeviceManager setup failed \n\n") + error);
00131    
00132    return;
00133   }
00134   
00135   //const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00136   lock.enter();
00137   
00138   if(numInputs_ > 0)
00139    input_ = AudioIn::AR(numInputs_);
00140   audioDeviceManager.addAudioCallback (this);
00141   
00142   lock.exit();
00143  }

00151  void audioDeviceIOCallback (const float** inputChannelData,
00152         int numInputChannels, 
00153         float** outputChannelData, 
00154         int numOutputChannels, 
00155         int numSamples)
00156  {
00157   // may need to be a bit cleverer with the channels in here..
00158   //const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00159   lock.enter();
00160   
00161   int blockID = UGen::getNextBlockID(numSamples);
00162   
00163   if(numInputs_ > 0)
00164    input_.setInputs(inputChannelData, numSamples, numInputChannels);
00165   
00166   if(numOutputs_ > 0)
00167   {
00168    output_.setOutputs(outputChannelData, numSamples, numOutputChannels);
00169 
00170    for(int i = 0; i < others.size(); i++)
00171    {
00172     others[i].prepareAndProcessBlock(numSamples, blockID);
00173    }
00174    
00175    output_.prepareAndProcessBlock(numSamples, blockID);
00176   }
00177   else
00178   {
00179    for(int i = 0; i < others.size(); i++)
00180    {
00181     others[i].prepareAndProcessBlock(numSamples, blockID);
00182    }
00183   }
00184   
00185   lock.exit();
00186  }
